content.title: Gratis ICO Converter & Favicon Generator
content.p1: Maakt u een website? Dan heeft u een favicon nodig - dat kleine pictogram dat in browsertabs verschijnt.
content.p2: Onze ICO Converter transformeert elke PNG- of JPG-afbeelding in een standaard Microsoft `.ico`-bestand. We ondersteunen alle gangbare favicon-formaten om ervoor te zorgen dat uw merk er op elk apparaat scherp uitziet.

why.title: Waarom .ICO formaat?
why.p1: Hoewel moderne browsers PNG-favicons ondersteunen, is het `.ico`-formaat nog steeds de standaard voor maximale compatibiliteit met alle besturingssystemen en legacy-browsers (zoals Internet Explorer).

faq.title: Veelgestelde vragen
faq.a1: ICO is an image file format purely dedicated to computer icons. It can contain multiple images at different sizes and color depths, allowing it to scale appropriately.
faq.q2: Why do I need a favicon?
faq.a2: A favicon helps users locate your website when they have multiple tabs open. It also adds a professional touch to your site and strengthens your brand identity.
faq.a3: 16x16 is essential for browser tabs. 32x32 is often used for taskbars. 48x48 is for desktop icons. We recommend generating a multi-size ICO that includes all of them.
faq.q4: Can I convert back from ICO to PNG?
faq.a4: This tool is for creating ICO files. To convert the other way, please use our ICO to PNG converter tool.
faq.q5: Is the generated ICO file compatible with all browsers?
faq.a5: Yes, properly generated .ico files are supported by all major browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and older versions like Internet Explorer.
